N-085_seamless_infinite_loop.pipeline: reference-image-input → prompt → text-gen → video-reference → video-gen → video-concat → download
notes: STAGE 1 — LOOP DESIGN A loop is written backwards: decide the frame, then design a move that returns to it exactly.

STAGE 2 — LOOP BUILD The same clip concatenated with itself proves the seam. If the join reads, re-generate before shipping. The second generator is a prompt-only video-gen node: it uses only handles confirmed in the platform export, so it is the fallback if the reference-image slots behave unexpectedly after import.

N-087_transformation_timelapse.title: Transformation: a long process compressed into thirty seconds
N-087_transformation_timelapse.summary: INPUTS Product, character and world references plus the written brief.
N-087_transformation_timelapse.pipeline: reference-image-input → character-input → background-input → prompt → 5× text-gen → 3× video-reference → video-concat → 2× text-gen → lyria-3 → merge-audio-video → text-gen → video-subtitle → download
notes: STAGE 1 — INPUTS Product, character and world references plus the written brief. Leave any input you do not need empty.
STAGE 2 — STRATEGY Turns a loose brief into a hard campaign spine: one job, one tension, one through-line device, locked look.
STAGE 3 — THE 30s SCRIPT Written as one continuous film that happens to be cut at the 10s and 20s marks — that is what makes the three clips join invisibly.
STAGE 4 — 3 x 10s CLIPS One writer and one generator per segment. Each writer reads the whole script and extracts only its own segment, carrying the handoff frame from its neighbour.
STAGE 5 — ASSEMBLY 3 clips concatenated in order into the finished 30-second film.
